title: Decision Arena harness: frozen, operator-paid capture of RISE's cases across deciders
acceptance: scripts/arena/arena.mjs capture asks openai (Decisions API), jev, kev, rules and rules-floor the 39 fixed cases through the browser's own request and admitAnswers, keeping raw and admitted decisions; tested with mocked fetch only.

A billed capture refuses under CI, without --bill-operator, from a dirty harness, and before any call if the estimate passes --max-usd (at most 20); at the cap it stops, keeps what was paid for and writes the run marked partial; keys are never written, printed or thrown; tested.

The run is written once (wx) as public/content/arena/run-<sha12>.json with a slim replay-<sha12>.json beside it (run 1 of the 39 cases: admitted decision or reject code per decider; no controls, no raw answers) and index.json, schema syberlabs.decision-arena/v1; scripts/arena/arena-file.mjs refuses an unknown schema, a dirty non-mock harness and a hash/name mismatch; tested. readArenaReplay accepts a replay only as the exact bytes its run file derives; tested.

report re-derives scores (valid, out-of-menu, explicit and contrast agreement raw and admitted, stability of choices, latency, cost per 1k) byte-identically; calibration from #531 per expected question only when the run records calibrationVersion; controls stay sealed until report --reveal-seed-file. The report states agreement per run (run 1 the headline) beside stability across runs, explicit agreement with a seeded case-clustered 95% bootstrap interval, contrast pairs with a 95% Wilson interval over run 1, and a paired case-clustered difference with withinNoise for each pair of deciders that ran; computed only in report output, never in run.scores.
Nothing under src/ imports the harness, and the app and dist/ never name api.openai.com or gpt-6-luna; tested.

evidence.note: node --test scripts/arena/arena.test.mjs: 13/13 pass on branch arena/harness (guards, split probe, refusal, keys never logged, budget, Kev not run, Jev cost, rules, mock run accepted and report byte-identical, src import guard, no OpenAI endpoint in src/public/dist). Mocked fetch only; no paid call.
arena-file moved from src/core/decision to scripts/arena (node:crypto, node:test); nothing in src/ imports it.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: a --mock capture from a clean commit wrote a 3.0 MB run (585 results), readArenaRun accepted it, report printed byte-identical output twice with matchesRecorded true; the mock output was deleted, not committed. Not merged, not deployed, no billed run.

Review fixes: node --test scripts/arena/arena.test.mjs scripts/arena/arena-file.test.mjs: 20 pass, 1 skipped (controls reveal needs #531's controls.mjs); with #531's files present, 37/37 pass including calibration.test.mjs. Both files now run in the CI Fast release checks.

Rebased on main with #531 (ac8a3f9d): calibration imported statically, skip path removed. CI node --test line incl. calibration.test.mjs: 62/62 pass; vitest decision, system-design, cloudflare-headers: 114/114 pass.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: --mock --runs 2 capture wrote a 4.55 MB run (890 results incl. 50 controls) and a 288 KB replay (39 cases, 5 deciders); report printed identical bytes twice with matchesRecorded and matchesReplay true; the replay regenerated byte-identical. Outputs deleted, not committed. Not merged, not deployed, no billed run.

Branch arena/first-free-run: a capture asking only rules, rules-floor or kev needs no --bill-operator (still refused under CI); each decider left out of --deciders is recorded as "not run: <reason>" from --not-run, in the run, its scores and its replay; the replay route shows that reason.

Integrity fixes before the first real run: canonical run bytes only; control labels drawn from sha256(JSON.stringify(run.results)); unrun deciders scored as {status}, not zeros; partial runs scored over reached cases; arena.test.mjs checks every committed index entry (files exist, hashes match, no mocks, append-only against origin/main when fetched); the replay route passes over a partial run while a complete one exists.
CI node --test line (decision-eval, arena, arena-file, calibration, local bridge/hardware/launcher): 67 pass, 0 fail on branch arena/first-free-run; vitest arena-replay and system-design: 13/13 pass.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: first real (not mock) capture, $0, from clean commit ee72038d: rules and rules-floor ran; openai and jev not run: no key; kev not run: hardware/setup (pinned weights download stalled on the Apple Silicon path). 534 results incl. 50 controls x 3 runs; run 1,615,849 bytes, replay 131,598 bytes. report printed identical bytes twice, matchesRecorded and matchesReplay true; controls sealed. Write-up: docs/decision-arena/RUN-2026-10-08.md. Branch only: not merged, not deployed.

Branch arena/case-intervals: CI node --test line (decision-eval, arena, arena-file, calibration, local bridge/hardware/launcher): 70 pass, 0 fail, including the new tests that repeats of a deterministic decider do not narrow its interval and that every committed run still reports matchesRecorded true with an agreement block.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: report on the committed run printed identical bytes twice, matchesRecorded and matchesReplay true. agreement: rules explicit 41/49 (0.837, case-clustered 95% 0.745 to 0.925), contrast 18/19 (Wilson 0.754 to 0.991); rules-floor explicit 12/49 (0.245, 0.070 to 0.440), contrast 0/19 (0 to 0.168); rules minus rules-floor 0.592 (0.383 to 0.800) over 39 shared cases, withinNoise false; all three runs identical. Branch only: not merged, not deployed.

summary: The benchmark harness for the Decision Arena: an operator-paid, offline capture frozen into a content-addressed file, scored deterministically. No billed run is part of this task.
